goal: Design a new set of compiler phases for forgetti on oxc and magic-string that keep the tree cache, are sound on React 19 and Preact 11, and beat both forgetti 0.8 and React Compiler 1.0 on the measured corpus

claims.text: 8 cores, 8 GB RAM, about 3.4 GB free, load 5.8. capacity.py recommends 1 parallel worktree, limited by CPU. 26 GB free disk.

On the 15-file corpus, forgetti 0.8.5 output differs from uncompiled React in 3 cases (forloop stale rows, usectx stale context, bailout cached side effect). React Compiler 1.0.0 output differs in 0 cases.
forgetti 0.8 output is 1.7 to 4.3 times larger than React Compiler output in raw bytes on the 14 files React Compiler compiled, and uses 2 to 4 times more slots.

Neither compiler wins on re-renders. React Compiler re-renders fewer children on jsxprops, earlyreturn and deepprop. forgetti 0.8 re-renders or recomputes less on derived, hook, ternary, map (Row1 against Row3 on one replaced item) and mutate.

Platform constraints: useMemo may discard its cache; use() may be called in branches and loops and must not be cached; other hooks keep a fixed order before any early return; react/compiler-runtime c() is undocumented and absent in Preact 11; Preact 11 compares deps with Object.is.

Lab prior art: solid-optimizer is an oxc-parser plus magic-string compiler of 15,588 lines of TypeScript (scope.ts alone is 707 lines), built over 251 commits. silmaril is 9,119 lines and solid-styled 3,294 lines on the same stack.

evidence.source: git ls-files '*.ts' | xargs cat | wc -l in each repo

claims.text: forgetti 0.8 compiler source is 3,849 lines (src/ plus runtime/) with 50 snapshot tests.

Fixed by the user: oxc-parser plus magic-string, the tree cache stays, React 19 and Preact 11 are the targets, and the phases must not follow React Compiler's design. React Compiler is only measured as a black box.

evidence.source: user prompt 2026-11-21: 'stick in the concept of a tree cache structure', 'consideration of React 19 and latest Preact', 'DO NOT FOLLOW THE REACT COMPILER'; toolchain answer 'oxc + magic-string'
evidence.detail: fixed choices, not open to the debate

claims.text: Context an agent loads to work on the compiler: research.md is about 2,400 words; forgetti 0.8 src is about 3,700 lines (roughly 35k tokens); the corpus is 15 files under 40 lines each.

Prior art outside the lab: React Compiler 1.0 (released 2025-10-07) builds a control-flow IR, infers mutation and aliasing effects, and groups values into reactive scopes over one flat cache from useMemoCache. Million Lint and forgetti 0.8 work on the AST without a mutation model.

evidence.detail: negative result for 0.8: J2 divergences come from the missing mutation and hook model
